item.title: github: GitHub Copilot weekly releases — September 7
item.description:
GitHub Copilot’s Sept. 7 weekly release adds Jira integration in Copilot app and adaptive model orchestration via Project HydraFusion in Copilot CLI. It also introduces new agent automation in Visual Studio Code.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot for Jira is now generally available
item.description:
GitHub Copilot for Jira is now generally available after a public preview that began in March 2026. GitHub says it has added several improvements since preview, including model selection.

  • Source: GitHub
